dbConfirmSql.statusHistory310to350: SELECT h.id, m.status_code, m.backend_status, m.status_name, h.provider_timestamp, h.occurred_at FROM booking_item_status_history h JOIN booking_status_mapping m ON m.id = h.status_mapping_id JOIN booking_item bi ON bi.id = h.booking_item_id JOIN booking b ON b.id = bi.booking_id WHERE b.booking_reference = 'BR1787744137248898' ORDER BY h.id;
dbConfirmSql.tripRow: SELECT t.* FROM booking b JOIN booking_item bi ON bi.booking_id = b.id AND bi.service_type = 'cabs' JOIN booking_item_cab bic ON bic.booking_item_id = bi.id LEFT JOIN booking_item_cab_trip t ON t.booking_item_cab_id = bic.id WHERE b.booking_reference = 'BR1787744137248898';
dbConfirmSql.otpA31: SELECT bic.otp, a.trip_otp, a.driver_name, a.vehicle_registration_no FROM booking b JOIN booking_item bi ON bi.booking_id = b.id AND bi.service_type = 'cabs' JOIN booking_item_cab bic ON bic.booking_item_id = bi.id LEFT JOIN booking_item_cab_assignment a ON a.booking_item_cab_id = bic.id WHERE b.booking_reference = 'BR1787744137248898' ORDER BY a.id DESC;
